job.message: containerlab restarted the device, but its container is exited (Exited (1) 2 seconds ago) right after starting. Known limit of the vJunos-switch image: its container cannot be started a second time (the launcher renames its init.conf on the first start and fails without it), so this restart leaves the device stopped until you redeploy the lab. Proven on vjunos-switch 23.2R1.14 with containerlab 0.79.0. Redeploy the lab to recreate the device; configuration changes that were not saved to its startup configuration are lost either way.
